title: ListAnniversariesRequest
description: Lists active Anniversary records with countdown projections. Missing category_ids or importance means no filter; supplied arrays must be non-empty. kind/count_mode filters are intentionally absent because they are not Anniversary domain facts. V1 supports page/page_size pagination; a non-null pagination.cursor is reserved and returns FEATURE_NOT_IMPLEMENTED until an Anniversary cursor encoding is frozen. Sorting is accepted only through the top-level sort_by and sort_direction fields.

timezone.description: IANA timezone used to calculate each local-date countdown.

pagination.description: Anniversary-specific pagination fragment. Sorting fields are intentionally excluded; use the top-level sort_by and sort_direction fields.

sort_by.description: The only sort-key location for Anniversary list. Missing means target_occurrence_date. Ties are resolved by Anniversary id for stable pagination.

sort_direction.description: The only sort-direction location for Anniversary list. Missing means asc.
